description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimulus types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into nine slices, each representing a distinct stimulus type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages, and are colored differently, although the colors are not explicitly defined in a legend. The categories and their approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (26.4%, red), Event Posting (6.6%, pink), Organizational Report (7.7%, light purple), Organizational Website (4.9%, purple), Interview (8.8%, dark blue), Intra-agency (8.6%, light blue), External News Article (18.1%, green), Email (2.7%, light green), and Social Media Post (1.1%, orange), and Press Release (18.7%, yellow). The percentages are displayed next to each label, outside the chart. The slices are arranged in a seemingly random order, with no apparent pattern or ranking.
